tagline.en: China's first national trunk line finished as expressway end to end, assembled from twenty projects over thirteen years
tagline.zh: 中国第一条全线建成高速公路的国道主干线，分 20 个路段、历时 13 年拼接而成

start.en: The Wuning Road interchange on Shanghai's Middle Ring Road, in Putuo district
start.zh: 上海市普陀区中环路武宁路立交

end.en: Shibalidian Bridge on Beijing's south-east Fourth Ring Road — kilometre 0; a free stretch of the old Jing–Jin–Tang road continues in to Fenzhongsi Bridge on the Third Ring
end.zh: 北京东南四环十八里店桥——零公里点；原京津塘高速的免费路段继续向内延伸至东南三环分钟寺桥

en: G2 runs south-east from Beijing across the North China Plain to the Yangtze delta, 1,222 km on the national chainage: through Langfang and Tianjin, Cangzhou in Hebei, Leling, Jinan, Laiwu and Linyi in Shandong, then Xinyi, Huai'an, Jiangdu, Jiangyin, Wuxi and Suzhou in Jiangsu, to Shanghai. Shandong and Jiangsu carry most of it, 449 km and 485 km.

It is less a single road than a chain of older ones under one number. Beijing to Tianjin is the Jing–Jin–Tang expressway; south of the Yangtze it borrows the Xicheng expressway from Jiangyin to Wuxi and then the Shanghai–Nanjing expressway, which it shares with G42, into Shanghai. Because the signs at the Shanghai boundary sit outside the city's ring expressway, the posted Jiangsu–Shanghai line is not where most people expect it.
zh: G2 自北京向东南穿越华北平原直抵长江三角洲，按国家里程桩号全长 1,222 公里：经廊坊、天津、河北沧州，山东乐陵、济南、莱芜、临沂，江苏新沂、淮安、江都、江阴、无锡、苏州，抵达上海。山东与江苏两省占了大半，分别为 449 公里和 485 公里。
与其说它是一条路，不如说是挂在同一个编号下的一串老路。北京至天津是京津塘高速；过长江后，江阴至无锡借用锡澄高速，再沿与 G42 共线的沪宁高速进入上海。由于路牌上标示的沪苏省界设在上海绕城高速以外，标出的省界位置与一般认知并不相同。

en: As completed in 2000 the road had 90 interchanges, 985 bridges and 20 service areas, and was designed for 120 km/h. Most of it was four lanes; the stretch from Qihe to Jinniushan near Tai'an and the 51 km of approaches to the Jiangyin bridge were built with six.

The Jiangyin Yangtze River Bridge, begun in November 1994 and opened on 28 September 1999, carries the road across the river between Jingjiang and Jiangyin. Its main span of 1,385 metres made it at the time the longest suspension bridge in China and the fourth longest in the world; the whole bridge is 3,071 metres, the towers 193 metres high, with 50 metres of clearance for shipping. It won the International Bridge Conference's Eugene C. Figg medal in 2002.

The Shandong section crosses the Yellow River at Jinan and, between Jinan and Laiwu, climbs through the hills with a run of tunnels — Youlanyu, Huolu, Jinyangguan and others. The Shanghai–Nanjing section, built as four lanes in 1992–1996, was widened to eight in 2003–2005 by adding two lanes either side while traffic kept running.
zh: 2000 年建成时，全线共有互通式立交 90 处、桥梁 985 座、服务区 20 个，设计时速 120 公里。大部分路段为四车道；齐河至泰安金牛山一段及江阴长江大桥南北接线 51 公里按六车道修建。
江阴长江大桥 1994 年 11 月开工，1999 年 9 月 28 日通车，在靖江与江阴之间把这条路送过长江。主跨 1,385 米，是当时中国第一、世界第四的悬索桥；桥梁全长 3,071 米，塔高 193 米，桥下通航净高 50 米。2002 年获国际桥梁大会颁发的尤金·菲戈奖。
山东段在济南跨越黄河，济南至莱芜之间穿行山地，接连有有兰峪、伙路、锦阳关等多座隧道。沪宁段 1992—1996 年按四车道建成，2003—2005 年在原路基两侧各加两车道，边通车边施工，扩建为八车道。

en: Its oldest part is the first expressway the mainland ever approved. The Beijing–Tianjin–Tanggu expressway was approved in April 1984, but took long enough to build that it was not the first to open: work began in December 1987, Beijing to Yangcun opened in September 1990, and the whole road on 25 September 1993. The Shanghai–Nanjing expressway followed — studied with Japanese experts under a bilateral agreement in 1986–87, approved in February 1991, begun on 14 June 1992 and opened in September 1996, cutting the drive between the two cities from six or seven hours to under three.

In the 1992 trunk plan Beijing–Shanghai was not one of the twelve lines but one of three 'important sections' to be finished early. The remaining links — Qingxian to Wuqiao in Hebei, Linyi to Honghuabu in Shandong, Xinyi to Jiangdu in Jiangsu — were finished in November and December 2000, and on 18 December the transport minister, Huang Zhendong, declared China's first national trunk line complete. North of Tianjin, though, the traffic still used 28.5 km of the city's outer ring, built to first-class road standard rather than expressway, until the 90 km Tianjin main line from Sicundian to Dazhangtun opened in 2006.

The number G2 came with the '7918' national plan in January 2005, which counts the Beijing radials clockwise from due north. The route has since been straightened: Xinhua reported a new line from Jinan to Leling open on 1 January 2015, and Leling to Cangzhou followed on 30 June 2016, shortening the road between Jinan and Beijing by about 50 km.
zh: 它最老的一段，是中国大陆批准修建的第一条高速公路。京津塘高速公路 1984 年 4 月获批，但因工期较长未能成为第一条通车的高速公路：1987 年 12 月动工，1990 年 9 月北京至天津杨村段通车，1993 年 9 月 25 日全线贯通。随后是沪宁高速：1986—1987 年根据中日政府间科技合作协定与日方专家共同开展可行性研究，1991 年 2 月获批，1992 年 6 月 14 日开工，1996 年 9 月通车，南京至上海的车程由六七个小时缩短到 3 小时以内。

在 1992 年的国道主干线规划中，京沪并不是十二条线之一，而是要求提前建成的“三个重要路段”之一。最后几段——河北青县至吴桥、山东临沂至红花埠、江苏新沂至江都——于 2000 年 11、12 月相继竣工；12 月 18 日，交通部部长黄镇东宣布中国第一条国道主干线全线贯通。不过天津北段仍借用 28.5 公里按一级公路标准修建的天津外环线作为代用线，直到 2006 年泗村店至大张屯 90 公里的天津段正线通车。
G2 这个编号来自 2005 年 1 月公布的“7918 网”，首都放射线自正北起按顺时针方向编号。此后线路又被拉直：新华社于 2015 年 1 月 1 日报道新线济南至乐陵段通车，乐陵至沧州段随后于 2016 年 6 月 30 日通车，济南至北京的距离缩短约 50 公里。

en: When it was declared complete in 2000 the road had cost about 39.3 billion yuan for 1,262 km, built as twenty sections by the six provinces and municipalities it crosses. The Shanghai–Nanjing expressway, of which G2 uses the part east of Wuxi, was budgeted at 7.04 billion yuan for its whole length and came in at 6.21 billion; widening it to eight lanes a decade later was put at close to another 10 billion.

The Jing–Jin–Tang section was the first expressway in China built with a World Bank loan and let by open international tender under FIDIC contract conditions. Under agreements signed on 14 September 1987, the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development lent US$25 million and the International Development Association provided credit of SDR 98.9 million.
Like other mainland expressways it is tolled. In 2000 a car paid about 535 yuan for the full distance, a drive of about twelve hours.
zh: 2000 年宣布全线贯通时，这条 1,262 公里的公路总投资约 393 亿元，由沿线六个省市分 20 个路段建成。沪宁高速（G2 使用其无锡以东部分）全线概算 70.4 亿元，实际投资 62.1 亿元；十年后扩建为八车道，投资又据称接近百亿元。
京津塘段是中国大陆第一条利用世界银行贷款、按菲迪克（FIDIC）条款进行国际公开招标建设的高速公路。根据 1987 年 9 月 14 日签订的协定，国际复兴开发银行提供 2,500 万美元贷款，国际开发协会另提供 9,890 万特别提款权的开发信贷。
与中国大陆其他高速公路一样，它收取通行费。2000 年小车跑完全程收费约 535 元，用时约 12 小时。

en: The Beijing section of the old Jing–Jin–Tang road is limited to 90 km/h, and the rest of that road towards Tianjin to 110 km/h. From 10 October to 26 November 2026 the Jiangyin bridge is under strengthening works and only one lane is open towards Shanghai; the new Jiangyin–Jingjiang Yangtze tunnel nearby is the alternative crossing.
zh: 原京津塘高速北京段限速每小时 90 公里，该路往天津方向的其余路段限速 110 公里。2026 年 10 月 10 日至 11 月 26 日，江阴长江大桥实施安全韧性提升施工，往上海方向仅保留一条车道；附近新通车的江阴靖江长江隧道可作为替代过江通道。

value.en: About 39.3 billion yuan for 1,262 km, as announced on completion in December 2000. This excludes the 2006 Tianjin main line and the 2015–16 Jinan–Cangzhou realignment, for which no cost was found.
value.zh: 2000 年 12 月全线贯通时公布，1,262 公里总投资约 393 亿元。不含 2006 年天津段正线及 2015—2016 年济南至沧州新线，后两者未查到造价。

figures.source: People's Daily, 19 December 2000, p. 1; Shenghuo Shibao (Guangming Online), 19 December 2000, citing Xinhua

value.en: Budgeted at 7.04 billion yuan, actual 6.21 billion (1992–1996), for the whole 274 km Shanghai–Nanjing road, of which G2 uses the part east of Wuxi; the 2003–2005 eight-lane widening was reported at close to 10 billion
value.zh: 沪宁高速全线 274 公里概算 70.4 亿元，实际投资 62.1 亿元（1992—1996），G2 使用其中无锡以东部分；2003—2005 年八车道扩建据报道投资近百亿元

figures.source: Wang Mingliang, 中国发展报告 1997, pp. 119–120; Guangming Daily, 12 May 2003; both as cited in Chinese Wikipedia, 沪宁高速公路

value.en: 3.5 billion yuan in the article's text, 3.625 billion in its infobox (1994–1999); neither checked against an original source
value.zh: 条目正文为 35 亿元，信息框为 36.25 亿元（1994—1999）；两者均未与原始来源核对

figures.source: Chinese Wikipedia, 江阴长江大桥

value.en: The six provinces and municipalities along the route, repaid from tolls; the Jing–Jin–Tang section with World Bank finance — a US$25 million IBRD loan and an IDA credit of SDR 98.9 million (1987).
value.zh: 沿线六省市出资，以通行费还贷；京津塘段利用世界银行资金——国际复兴开发银行贷款 2,500 万美元及国际开发协会信贷 9,890 万特别提款权（1987 年）。

figures.source: Loan Agreement (Beijing–Tianjin–Tanggu Expressway Project) between the PRC and the IBRD, 14 September 1987, text at lvga.com; Shenghuo Shibao, 19 December 2000

value.zh: 互通式立交 90 处、桥梁 985 座、分离式立交 186 座、服务区 20 个

figures.source: Shenghuo Shibao (Guangming Online), 19 December 2000, citing Xinhua

value.zh: 按国家里程桩号 1,222 公里（2000 年建成时、改线前为 1,262 公里）

timeline.en: The Beijing–Tianjin–Tanggu expressway is approved in April — the first expressway approved on the mainland.
timeline.zh: 4 月，京津塘高速公路获批，为中国大陆获准修建的第一条高速公路。

timeline.en: World Bank loan agreements are signed on 14 September; work on Jing–Jin–Tang begins in December.
timeline.zh: 9 月 14 日签订世界银行贷款协定；12 月京津塘高速动工。
9 月，北京至天津杨村段通车。

timeline.en: Jing–Jin–Tang opens in full on 25 September.
timeline.zh: 9 月 25 日，京津塘高速全线贯通。

timeline.en: The Shanghai–Nanjing expressway opens in September.
The Jiangyin Yangtze River Bridge opens on 28 September.
timeline.zh: 9 月 28 日，江阴长江大桥通车。

timeline.en: The last sections open and on 18 December the whole road is declared complete, 1,262 km for about 39.3 billion yuan.
timeline.zh: 最后几段竣工，12 月 18 日宣布全线贯通，全长 1,262 公里，总投资约 393 亿元。

timeline.en: The '7918' plan numbers the route G2; Shanghai–Nanjing eight-laning is completed in December.
timeline.zh: “7918 网”规划将该线编为 G2；12 月沪宁段八车道扩建完工。

timeline.en: The 90 km Tianjin main line opens, ending the detour over Tianjin's outer ring road.
timeline.zh: 天津段正线 90 公里通车，不再绕行天津外环代用线。

timeline.en: The new Leling–Cangzhou line opens on 30 June, completing a shorter route between Jinan and Beijing.
timeline.zh: 6 月 30 日，新京沪高速乐陵至沧州段通车，济南至北京的新线全线贯通。

timeline.en: Strengthening works on the Jiangyin bridge reduce it to one lane towards Shanghai from 10 October.
timeline.zh: 10 月 10 日起，江阴长江大桥加固施工，往上海方向仅留一条车道。
